methods_quotes.q: The national and regional baselines are the mean percentages of visits for ILI during noninfluenza weeks for the previous three seasons plus two standard deviations.
The epidemic threshold is set at 1.645 standard deviations above the seasonal baseline.
Cumulative unadjusted incidence rates are calculated using CDC’s National Center for Health Statistics population estimates
The seasonal baseline proportion of P&I deaths is projected using a robust regression procedure
CDC estimates the cumulative prevalence of influenza using the cumulative rates of influenza-associated hospitalizations reported through FluSurv-NET and a mathematical model.
